DigitsCNN(
  (features): Sequential(

    (2): Conv2d(16, 16, kernel_size=(3, 3), stride=(1, 1), padding=(1, 1))

  (classifier): Sequential(
    (0): Linear(in_features=1024, out_features=64, bias=True)

construction_timing_scope: fixed method order within architecture worker; first import/cache overhead charged to actual first consumer; no isolated per-method cold-cost ranking

exact_feature_duplicate_check.method: np.unique(original bundled data, axis=0); root read-only verification

data.preprocessing: MLP fitted on train only; Digits fixed division by16
data.selection: all frozen candidates evaluated; test never changes protocol or model

failure_policy: retain every candidate and baseline gate failure; no seed/ridge/dtype/rank substitution
inference: descriptive paired local experiment with3 seeds, not universal article reproduction
local_error: direct isolated layer MSE on frozen baseline inputs, distinct from propagated activation drift

matching.equal_budget: complete unique model tensor bytes, including all biases, buffers and untouched tensors
matching.equal_rank: same stored rank vector and same operators within cohort
matching.not_matched: serialized artifact and descriptor bytes; measured separately
matching.redundancy: all selected operators have bias and two factors; equal rank and equal tensor-budget cases coincide

resources.cpu_monitor: recursive CPU-time delta in core-percent units; inactive OS threads are counted separately from configured computation threads
resources.memory_monitor: all owned recursive child processes; conservative12GiB cap on both individual RSS and tree RSS sum; shared pages may be counted repeatedly in sum

prior_compute_ledger.status: retained prior attempt; instrumentation superseded, no test-driven model selection

resources.processes: one computational worker at a time; CPU only; no cluster

supplementary_work_count: root may report analytic MAC estimates excluding bias/activation/normalization; not measured time or extra success criterion

timing.runtime: TorchScript reloaded in a fresh isolated subprocess per artifact
timing.speed_claims: none under background load; raw session observations only
timing.statistical_unit: one timing session per artifact; training seeds are separate

training.checkpoint_selection: fixed final epoch; no validation/test selection

weighted_policy.joint_collection: features.0 then features.2 then classifier.0; current graph after each replacement
weighted_policy.known_limitation: singular calibration moments do not constrain unseen nullspace action
